lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let T := ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (timeOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕))
  let U := LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι c) ∘ₗ T
  rw [map_mul ι]
  change ((mulLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ c)).compr₂ T) a b =
    (mulLinearMap.compr₂ U) a b
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun
    (ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs' => ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs => ?_) a) b
  change T (ofCrAnListFBasis φs' * c * ofCrAnListFBasis φs) =
    ι c * T (ofCrAnListFBasis φs' * ofCrAnListFBasis φs)
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  have ht (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
      T (ofCrAnListF l) = crAnTimeOrderSign l •
        ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList l)) := by
    simp only [T, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
      timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, map_smul]
  let l1 := (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
      ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)) ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
  let l2 := (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs) ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
      ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)
  have hs (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
      (h : ∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
      ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs))) =
        ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2) := by
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ φs' l φs h]
    simp only [l1, l2, decide_not, Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, mul_assoc]
  simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at hs
  have h1 := hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  have h2 := hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h1 h2
  calc
    _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι c *
          ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
      conv_lhs =>
        dsimp only [c]
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
        simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
          map_sub T, map_smul T, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
          List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
        rw [ht, ht]
      rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, h1, h2]
      dsimp only [c]
      rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
      simp only [map_sub, map_smul, map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append,
        mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
        smul_sub]
      rw [smul_comm]
    _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (ι c *
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φs)))) := by
      dsimp only [c]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
        (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ), mul_assoc]
      have h0 := hs [] (by simp)
      simp only [List.nil_append, ofCrAnListF_nil, map_one, mul_one] at h0
      rw [h0]
    _ = _ := by
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign,
          Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ht]
        simp only [Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
      · simp only [c, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let T := ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (timeOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕))
  rw [map_mul ι]
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂
    (f := (mulLinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ T).comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ c))
    (g := mulLinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι c) ∘ₗ T))
    ?_ a b
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs'
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs
  simp only [LinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, mulLinearMap_apply,
    LinearMap.mulRight_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  let s := (φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel
  let x := ι (ofCrAnListF ((List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
      s) ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'))
  let y := ι (ofCrAnListF ((List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs) ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
      s))
  have hs (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
      (h : ∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
      T (ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ l ++ φs)) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ l ++ φs) •
          (x * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * y) := by
    simp only [T, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
      timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, map_smul]
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ φs' l φs h]
    simp only [x, y, s, decide_not, Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, mul_assoc]
  simp only [List.append_assoc] at hs
  have h1 := hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  have h2 := hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h1 h2
  calc
    _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (x * ι c *

      simp only [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
        map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, smul_sub]
      rw [h1, h2, ← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · have h0 := hs [] (by simp)
        simp at h0
        rw [crAnTimeOrderSign,
          Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, h0, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
        rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
          (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ), mul_assoc]
      · simp only [c, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, mul_zero, smul_zero]

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a* ofCrAnListF φs))
    change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pa]
      calc _
        /- Split the commutator. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
            crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
          module
        /- Simplify the signs. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
          rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
          module
        /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                      (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF
              (List.filter (fun c => decide (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
          have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
            (by simp_all)
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
          have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
            (by simp_all)
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by norm_num, h2]
          repeat rw [ofCrAnListF_append]
          simp only [ map_mul,
    Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
                ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
            simp only [
    Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, mul_sub, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
            congr
            rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
            simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      repeat rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
      simp only [ List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h1 ⊢
      rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by grind only),
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, pa]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simp_all only [map_mul, add_mul, map_add, mul_add, pa]
    · intro x hx hpx
      simp_all only [map_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, implies_true, pa]
  · simp only [map_mul, mul_zero, map_zero, pb]
  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
    simp_all only [map_mul, mul_add, map_add, pb]
  · intro x hx hpx
    simp_all only [map_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, implies_true, pb]

    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let T := ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (timeOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕))
  rw [map_mul ι]
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂
    (f := (mulLinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ T).comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ c))
    (g := mulLinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι c) ∘ₗ T))
    ?_ a b
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs'
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs
  simp only [LinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, mulLinearMap_apply,
    LinearMap.mulRight_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  let s := (φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel

      s) ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'))
  let y := ι (ofCrAnListF ((List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs) ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
      s))
  have hs (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
      (h : ∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
      T (ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ l ++ φs)) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ l ++ φs) •
          (x * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * y) := by
    simp only [T, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
      timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, map_smul]
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ φs' l φs h]
    simp only [x, y, s, decide_not, Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, mul_assoc]

    _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •

      simp only [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,

        List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, smul_sub]

          Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm,
